reason: Implements 31 unconditional MCP tools with real OAuth-backed GA4 Data/Admin HTTP handlers; one metadata tool has a routing defect, but remaining server implementation is viable.

tools.name: ga4_run_report
tools.description:
UNIVERSAL REPORT — run any GA4 report. propertyId is the numeric property ID.

dateRanges: array of { startDate, endDate }. Date format YYYY-MM-DD or relative like "today", "yesterday", "7daysAgo", "30daysAgo".

dimensions: array of { name } — examples: date, country, sessionDefaultChannelGroup, sessionSource, sessionMedium, deviceCategory, browser, pagePath, pageTitle, eventName, customEvent:my_param, audienceName, firstUserDefaultChannelGroup, etc.

metrics: array of { name } — examples: activeUsers, sessions, screenPageViews, eventCount, conversions, totalRevenue, engagedSessions, engagementRate, averageSessionDuration, bounceRate, transactions, purchaseRevenue, addToCarts, beginCheckouts.

dimensionFilter / metricFilter: filter expressions. Example: { "filter": { "fieldName": "sessionDefaultChannelGroup", "stringFilter": { "value": "Organic Search" } } }.

orderBys: [{ "dimension": { "dimensionName": "date" } }] or [{ "metric": { "metricName": "sessions" }, "desc": true }].

limit: max rows (default 1000, max 250000).
tools.behavior: Posts selected report fields to /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}:runReport. Defaults dates to 7daysAgo–yesterday, dimensions to [], limit to 1000, offset to 0, keepEmptyRows to false; forwards supplied filters, ordering and currency.
notes: Exposed report objects/items are intentionally unrestricted object schemas; nested GA API fields are not specified. Handler forwards only the fields described in behavior.
Description claims max limit 250000, but schema has no maximum and handler does not enforce it. Falsy limit (including 0) becomes 1000.

tools.name: ga4_run_realtime_report
tools.description: Real-time report (last 30 min of activity). Common metrics: activeUsers, screenPageViews, eventCount. Common dimensions: country, city, deviceCategory, browser, unifiedScreenName, eventName.

minuteRanges.description: [{name, startMinutesAgo, endMinutesAgo}] — defaults to last 30 min

tools.behavior: Posts metrics, dimensions (default []), limit (default 100) and optional filters/minuteRanges to /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}:runRealtimeReport.
notes: Exposed report objects/items are intentionally unrestricted object schemas; nested GA API fields are not specified. Handler forwards only the fields described in behavior.

tools.name: ga4_run_pivot_report
tools.description: Pivoted report (cross-tabulation). Useful for heatmap-style breakdowns. pivots: [{ fieldNames: ["country"], limit: 10, orderBys: [...], offset: 0 }].
tools.behavior: Posts metrics, pivots, dimensions (default []), dates (default 30daysAgo–yesterday) and optional dimensionFilter to /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}:runPivotReport.
notes: Exposed report objects/items are intentionally unrestricted object schemas; nested GA API fields are not specified. Handler forwards only the fields described in behavior.

tools.name: ga4_batch_run_reports
tools.description: Run up to 5 reports in a single API call. Reduces round trips for dashboards. requests: array of report bodies (same shape as ga4_run_report).
tools.behavior: Posts {requests} unchanged to /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}:batchRunReports.
notes: Exposed report objects/items are intentionally unrestricted object schemas; nested GA API fields are not specified. Handler forwards only the fields described in behavior.

tools.name: ga4_get_metadata
tools.description: List all dimensions + metrics available for a property (including custom ones). Use to discover what you can query.
tools.behavior: Calls ga4Get with /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}/metadata. Shared routing sends this GET to analyticsadmin.googleapis.com rather than the Data API metadata endpoint.
notes: Defect: /metadata does not match ga4Get routing predicates (:getMetadata is checked instead), so request uses Admin API host and cannot fetch Data API metadata as intended.

tools.name: ga4_check_compatibility
tools.description: Check whether requested dimensions + metrics are compatible (can be combined in one report).
tools.behavior: Posts dimensions and metrics, each defaulting to [], to /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}:checkCompatibility.
notes: Exposed report objects/items are intentionally unrestricted object schemas; nested GA API fields are not specified. Handler forwards only the fields described in behavior.

tools.name: ga4_list_account_summaries
tools.description: List all GA4 account summaries the authenticated user can access. Each includes property summaries — fastest way to discover all properties.
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/accountSummaries with pageSize default 200; returns the API response.
notes: No pagination loop or pageToken input: only first API response page is used.

tools.name: ga4_list_accounts
tools.description: List GA4 accounts.
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/accounts with pageSize default 50; returns the API response.
notes: No pagination loop or pageToken input: only first API response page is used.

tools.name: ga4_get_account
tools.description: Get a single GA4 account by name. name format: accounts/{accountId}
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/accounts/{accountId}; directly appends supplied accountId.

tools.name: ga4_list_properties
tools.description: List GA4 properties under an account. accountId must be the numeric ID (without "accounts/" prefix).
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/properties with filter parent:accounts/{accountId}, pageSize default 100, and showDeleted default false.
notes: No pagination loop or pageToken input: only first API response page is used.

tools.name: ga4_get_property
tools.description: Get a single property's settings.
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}; returns property settings.

tools.name: ga4_update_property
tools.description: Update GA4 property fields. updateMask is comma-separated list of fields to update (e.g. "displayName,timeZone,currencyCode,industryCategory").

payload.description: Fields to update — displayName, timeZone, currencyCode, industryCategory

tools.behavior: PATCH /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}?updateMask={encoded updateMask} using payload unchanged.

tools.name: ga4_list_data_streams
tools.description: List data streams in a GA4 property (web, app, etc.).
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}/dataStreams.
notes: No pagination loop or pageToken input: only first API response page is used.

tools.name: ga4_get_data_stream
tools.description: Get a data stream by ID, including the measurement ID and stream-specific settings.
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}/dataStreams/{streamId}.

tools.name: ga4_list_conversion_events
tools.description: List configured conversion events on a property.
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}/keyEvents; uses key events despite the conversion-events tool name.
notes: No pagination loop or pageToken input: only first API response page is used.

tools.name: ga4_create_conversion_event
tools.description: Mark an event as a key event (conversion). eventName is the event name to mark (e.g. "purchase", "generate_lead", "form_submit"). countingMethod: ONCE_PER_EVENT or ONCE_PER_SESSION.
tools.behavior: POST /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}/keyEvents with eventName, countingMethod default ONCE_PER_EVENT, and optional defaultValue unchanged.

tools.name: ga4_list_custom_dimensions
tools.description: List custom dimensions on a property.
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}/customDimensions.
notes: No pagination loop or pageToken input: only first API response page is used.

tools.name: ga4_create_custom_dimension
tools.description: Create a custom dimension. scope: EVENT | USER | ITEM. parameterName is the event/user parameter to bind.
tools.behavior: POST /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}/customDimensions with displayName, parameterName, scope default EVENT, and supplied description/disallowAdsPersonalization.
notes: Schema default disallowAdsPersonalization=false is not applied in handler; omitted field is undefined and omitted during JSON serialization.

tools.name: ga4_list_custom_metrics
tools.description: List custom metrics on a property.
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}/customMetrics.
notes: No pagination loop or pageToken input: only first API response page is used.

tools.name: ga4_create_custom_metric
tools.description: Create a custom metric. measurementUnit: STANDARD | CURRENCY | FEET | METERS | KILOMETERS | MILES | MILLISECONDS | SECONDS | MINUTES | HOURS.
tools.behavior: POST /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}/customMetrics with displayName, parameterName, scope default EVENT, measurementUnit, description and restrictedMetricType.
notes: measurementUnit is required despite its schema default STANDARD; handler does not apply that default. No enum constrains measurementUnit beyond its description.

tools.name: ga4_list_audiences
tools.description: List audiences on a property.
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}/audiences with pageSize default 50.
notes: No pagination loop or pageToken input: only first API response page is used.

tools.name: ga4_list_google_ads_links
tools.description: List Google Ads accounts linked to this property.
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}/googleAdsLinks.
notes: No pagination loop or pageToken input: only first API response page is used.

tools.name: ga4_list_bigquery_links
tools.description: List BigQuery export links on a property.
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}/bigQueryLinks.
notes: No pagination loop or pageToken input: only first API response page is used.

tools.name: ga4_create_bigquery_link
tools.description: Create a BigQuery export link. project must be a GCP project ID. dataLocation: US | EU | asia-south1 | etc. dailyExportEnabled = true for daily exports, streamingExportEnabled = true for streaming.
tools.behavior: POST /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}/bigQueryLinks with project prefixed projects/, dataLocation default US, dailyExportEnabled/includeAdvertisingId true unless explicitly false, streamingExportEnabled true only when explicitly true, and excludedEvents default [].

tools.name: ga4_list_users
tools.description: List access bindings (users) on an account or property. parent format: accounts/{id} or properties/{id}.
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/{parent}/accessBindings; parent directly supplies accounts/{id} or properties/{id} path.
notes: No pagination loop or pageToken input: only first API response page is used.

tools.name: ga4_get_attribution_settings
tools.description: Get the attribution model settings for a property.
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}/attributionSettings.

tools.name: ga4_get_data_retention_settings
tools.description: Get the data retention period for a property.
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}/dataRetentionSettings.

tools.name: ga4_universal_call
tools.description: UNIVERSAL — call any GA4 Data or Admin API endpoint. Use when no specialized tool exists. fullUrl must be the complete https URL (e.g. https://analyticsadmin.googleapis.com/v1beta/...).
tools.behavior: Passes method (default GET), arbitrary fullUrl and optional body to googleFetch. Uses the same OAuth bearer token and JSON serialization; returns parsed response or raw text.
api_methods: HTTP arbitrary method/fullUrl via OAuth-authenticated googleFetch
notes: fullUrl has no format/host/protocol restriction and handler does not restrict it to Google/GA4; body has no type restriction.

tools.name: ga4_quick_overview
tools.description: Cross-property snapshot: count of accessible accounts + properties + recent activity. Great as a starting point.
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/accountSummaries with pageSize 200, counts accounts and property summaries, returns first 10 account summaries and up to 3 sample properties per account.
notes: No pagination loop or pageToken input: only first API response page is used.
Description mentions recent activity, but implementation only reads account summaries and does not query activity.

tools.name: ga4_find_property
tools.description: Search across all your account summaries for properties matching a name substring (case-insensitive).
tools.behavior: GET /v1beta/accountSummaries with pageSize 500; scans property display names case-insensitively, using equality if exact is truthy and substring matching otherwise; returns match count and account/property metadata.
notes: No pagination loop or pageToken input: only first API response page is used.

tools.name: ga4_property_health_check
tools.description: Quick health report for a property: yesterday vs 7-day-ago totals, conversion event count, data stream count, last data received hint.
tools.behavior: Concurrently runs a report comparing yesterday and 7daysAgo for activeUsers, sessions, eventCount and conversions, lists key events and data streams. Returns raw report, event count/names, stream count and stream metadata. Each request catches errors independently.
notes: No pagination loop or pageToken input: only first API response page is used.
Description mentions last data received hint, but no such field is computed. Key-event/stream request errors are hidden as zero counts/empty arrays; report errors appear in yesterdayVs7dAgo.
Source review only, no tools/list or live requests; upstream code was not executed.

All 31 tools are registered unconditionally; google-client.js exits during import if OAuth client ID, client secret or refresh token are missing. Credentials come from environment variables or ~/.was-ga4-mcp/config.json.
cli.js auth/logout/status/help are CLI commands, not registered MCP tools. No optional modules or permission tiers were found.

Shared client refreshes OAuth tokens and performs authenticated fetch, parsing JSON or raw text; server returns text JSON, truncates output above 60000 characters, and converts exceptions to isError responses.
Server dispatcher passes arguments directly to handlers without explicit inputSchema validation or automatic default application.

review.method: Independently compared all 31 literal schemas/descriptions exactly; traced registry/dispatcher and native Google fetch routing, Admin writes/universal call and helper reports. Confirmed the metadata endpoint host defect directly in shared client.
